insights.summary: Notes from Day 1 of Hem Securities' Samruddhi Season 3 conference (posted 15 Jun 2026 by an attendee, not the company). Vivid repeated its FY26 numbers (revenue ₹201 Cr, EBITDA ₹46 Cr at 23%, PAT ₹32 Cr) and said data centres were ~49% of revenue, metro ~20% and industrial ~21%. The new Ambernath plant was due for Phase 1 commissioning in July/August 2026, lifting capacity from ~7,500 to ~22,500 units, with full use within three years; most of H1 FY27 revenue still comes from the old plants. The company aims to add the remaining 2-3 of India's top-10 hyperscalers within 3-6 months, double exports in FY27, and take on no more equity or debt. No FY27 revenue figure was given.
